details: The Ninapro site shows no visible license, but the page source of DB1 and DB4-DB8 carries a commented-out line naming Creative Commons Attribution No Derivatives 4.0 International (the only license statement found for the data; the CC BY on the 2014 Sci Data article covers the article, not the data).
